about_the_game:
The colorings and soundtrack are located in the game folder, in the DLC Colorings & OST catalog.

The colorings is a PDF file with sheets ready for printing on a standard office printer (A4 format), and is also available as separate page-by-page images. For coloring, watercolor markers are recommended.

The original soundtrack by The Foreign includes the following tracks:

1. Traveler’s Sight

2. What Was the Point of Opening the Shutters

3. No Prospect (Home Is My Shelter)

4. What Was the Point of Setting Up the Tent

5. Minor Encounter

6. Counterpart Soul

Additionally, the pack includes high-resolution desktop wallpapers.
